sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout returned 12 current-week candidates across llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; two same-table candidates were exact duplicates in the clean data ledger, so Intern-S2-Preview was selected.
Official arXiv, arXiv Atom, Hugging Face model card, and XTuner repository were checked; no unsupported third-party claims were used as primary evidence.
Article preserves boundaries around preview-system reliability, verifier quality, memory-domain conflicts, incomplete cost disclosure, and limited external reproducibility.
